boundary: No transaction: PageServlet.doGet resolves the weblog, template and (optionally) entry/category/tags, each read through JPAPersistenceStrategy.getEntityManager(false) auto-committing individually; rendering (renderer.render, PageServlet.java:511) then runs the Velocity page template, which pulls further reads through the loaded PageModel.

ops_fix.note: getTagComboExists builds 'SELECT DISTINCT w.name FROM WeblogEntryTagAggregate w WHERE ...' (JPAWeblogEntryManagerImpl.java:671-672, executed at :700); the JPQL entity name is static text, mapped by WeblogEntryTagAggregate.orm.xml:12 to table roller_weblogentrytagagg, so the table is resolvable, not unknown.

ops_add.note: The default weblog theme template calls '#set($pager = $model.getWeblogEntriesPager())' (themes/basic/weblog.vm:24); PageModel.getWeblogEntriesPager() (PageModel.java:214-304) returns WeblogEntriesPermalinkPager/DayPager/MonthPager/LatestPager depending on the request; the default case, WeblogEntriesLatestPager, calls getEntries() in its constructor (WeblogEntriesLatestPager.java:65), which calls JPAWeblogEntryManagerImpl.getWeblogEntryObjectMap (:84) -> getWeblogEntries (JPAWeblogEntryManagerImpl.java:849), a dynamic JPQL query against WeblogEntry (table weblogentry). Which pager variant runs depends on the request and theme; only the default theme/latest-pager path was traced.

notes: ModelLoader.loadModels (PageServlet.java:471,476) dispatches by class name to Model.init for PageModel/ConfigModel/UtilitiesModel/URLModel/MessageModel/CalendarModel/MenuModel (and SiteModel/PlanetModel if site-wide); only PageModel's entries pager was traced against the shipped 'basic' theme. Other themes, the permalink/day/month pager variants, and CalendarModel/MenuModel were not individually checked, so confidence is medium.
